facebook.content:
Marriage isn’t a contract; it’s a covenant seat of Kingdom authority. When you view your spouse as a co‑heir of God’s promise, every disagreement becomes a battle for the throne you share, not a personal offense. Hebrews 13:20 reminds us that “the God of peace…shall equip you with every good thing…to do His will.”  

What kingdom‑level authority will you claim today to honor your marriage?
